title: ASCENT — The Cipher Worlds
subtitle: Adaptive Algebra I mastery, built to a Fortnite / Breath of the Wild bar
summary: Wave A closed: 30 agents, zero passes. Critics scored world 3, fx 3, player 4, learn-ux 5. A coherence pass then unified the lighting to one golden hour, fixed aerial perspective, restored the player's shadow, and found the click-swallowing modal that had silently broken building since the first commit. 60fps on an M4. Wave B now re-enters every piece seeded with its exact unclosed gap.

pieces.name: World & art direction
pieces.note: Sightlines genuinely fixed - 4/5 far worlds unoccluded from spawn, ashen centre-frame at arrival, terrace runnable - but the horizon is flat paper triangles and black cutouts, the lookout does not read as built, and a straight run up the Spine renders pure black. 5/10.
